claims.scope: For every pair of Boolean functions on disjoint physical blocks, U, G=sum_i Delta_i U, and influence are exactly additive under pointwise product.
Every n-variable Boolean point defect satisfies G<=kappa_pd I with sharp class constant kappa_pd=37/4-(9/2)log_2(3), attained at n=3.
Every finite product of point defects on disjoint blocks satisfies G<=kappa_pd I with no dependence on total dimension, number of factors, block arities, or product-tree depth.
Extend the exact GU composition law from product/parity to a nontrivial outer gate while controlling the biased child laws created by physical restriction.
claims.unpaid_step: A balanced child becomes biased after restriction, so the root upper-mass chain rule cannot simply be subtracted at the children.
